in_sanskrit.name: जिग्नेश्
in_sanskrit.meaning: desiring to be known, eager to be known, earnest, ardent, or passionate
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Jignesh is derived from the Sanskrit word जिग्नः (jig-nah), which means 'desiring to be known, eager to be known, earnest, ardent, or passionate'. The suffix -ेश् (esh) is added to the root word to create the name Jignesh.

in_hindi.name: जिगनेश
in_hindi.long_meaning: The Hindi name Jignesh is identical to the Sanskrit form, and is pronounced similarly as 'जिग्नेश्' (jig-ne-sh).

in_tamil.name: ஜிக்னேஷ்
in_tamil.long_meaning: The Tamil form of the name Jignesh may be written in different ways depending on the Tamil script used, but is generally pronounced as 'ஜிக்க் னேஷ்' (ji-g-ne-sh).

in_telugu.name: జిగ్నేశ్
in_telugu.long_meaning: The Telugu form of the name Jignesh is identical to the Sanskrit and Hindi forms, and is pronounced similarly as 'జిగ్ నేశ్' (ji-g-ne-sh).

in_marathi.name: Jignesh
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jignesh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Jignesh is derived from Sanskrit words ‘jigh’ meaning to conquer and ‘nish’ meaning to rule or rule over. The name signifies a victorious person, one who conquers and rules over situations and challenges in life.
